name: fields
what: classical field handling planned from the measurements: QTGMC for interlace, TFM+TDecimate for telecine, sRestore for blended fields or frames, chroma-shift correction, the tape-noise mask when asked; deinterlacing, inverse telecine and un-blending change the frame count, chroma-shift correction and the mask do not
when: the analysis flags interlaced, telecine, blended or chroma_shift (it does nothing otherwise); first in almost every recipe, because every later step and every model needs clean progressive frames
